design.name: eight-neighbor-progress-aware-prefix-v1
design.pair_schedule: shuffle instance/repetition blocks and all three arms
design.objective: original completion_J with original and independent physical replay

fixed_frontier.key: original guide priority, original insertion serial

progress_policy.key: original guide priority, original insertion serial

config.selection_rule: first two registered primary date blocks per region; first particle seed per block

method_labels.C1_M: five-slot rolling with exact state merging
method_labels.D0: one-shot shadow index; no pruning or stale-pop skipping

objective.primary: sum of post-observation remaining masses k=1..K

search.initialization: reuse the same frozen H2 S30 route; copy and replay charged in each method
search.preparation_policy: No new drift, new forcing, new particle seed or sensor feedback
search.latency_model: Online computation consumes physical time while the aircraft follows the committed old route; only complete waypoint anchors; late replacement discarded

decision.rule_scope: development engineering screen, not significance or generalization proof

diagnostic_gate.denominator: nonterminal children submitted to index after original J pruning and before guide; root excluded
diagnostic_gate.numerator: exact matching key with stored J <= child.J; improved replacements excluded
diagnostic_gate.claim: shadow opportunity only; not active speedup or optimality proof

references.seed_generation_cost: historical S30 cost external and equal; route copy/replay charged per method
